## 3x3 colored blocks emit full grid lines

Observed and verified in task `task-8af43894` (solved correctly):

- Where emitted lines of different colors cross, make the crossing cell 0 (blank). This yields a one-cell gap in each of the two lines at the crossing.
- Other isolated nonzero cells are background/noise; emitted lines overwrite them. Preserve isolated cells not intersected by a line.
